claims.text: NCEL outperforms all baseline methods in both easy and hard cases, demonstrating its effectiveness in collective entity linking.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability across five public benchmarks.
The proposed model integrates local and global information effectively, enhancing its performance in entity linking tasks.
Extensive evaluations confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of NCEL in linking performance and generalization ability.
